## Summary
Production-focused DevOps, SRE, DevSecOps, and Cloud Infrastructure Engineer operating high-volume multi-tenant enterprise SaaS platforms across AWS (ECS, Lambda, DynamoDB, ALB, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM, VPC) and Azure (AKS, Application Insights, Azure Monitor, networking, RBAC). Specializing in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK), container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker Swarm, Helm), CI/CD automation (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI), shift-left DevSecOps (OWASP Top 10, SAST, DAST, SCA, Trivy, Snyk, SonarQube, Checkov, Gitleaks, SBOM, Cosign, Syft), enterprise SRE (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki, Alertmanager, SLI/SLO, MTTR, RCA), and AI-enabled operations (AIOps, intelligent observability, automated RCA).

## Standardized 10-Point Project Breakdown
Every project in the portfolio is evaluated across 10 explicit dimensions:
1. Problem: Operational bottleneck or vulnerability in high-throughput SaaS environments.
2. Architecture: End-to-end dataflow and system topology.
3. Technologies: Full tech stack (AWS, Azure, Terraform, K8s, CI/CD, Observability, Security, AI).
4. My Role: Explicit personal responsibility and lead engineering scope.
5. Implementation: Detailed breakdown of what was configured and delivered.
6. Security: OWASP Top 10, SAST, DAST, SCA, IAM/RBAC, secrets detection, SBOM, and Sigstore Cosign keyless signing.
7. Observability: Prometheus, Grafana RED metrics, Loki distributed tracing, Alertmanager, CloudWatch, and Application Insights.
8. Automation: IaC (Terraform modules, AWS CDK), automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and GitOps drift reconciliation.
9. Reliability: High Availability (HA), HPA autoscaling, SLI/SLO bounds, MTTR reduction, blameless RCA, and self-healing.
10. Results / Metrics: Quantifiable technical and business metrics (e.g., 99.99% availability, sub-15ms p95 latency, 68% MTTR triage reduction, zero-downtime database upgrades).
